Stable NEXUS resource URI (v1). Tenant/workspace carried in ActorContext, not in URI. Platform domains allow an optional sub-type segment matching vocabulary uri_segment (e.g. agent/run, skill/binding, workflow/run, workflow/template, tool/connection, tool/record (1.15.0: nexus://tool/record/<tool_id>:<record_id> — one record a tool returned), sandbox/profile, model/provider, model/invocation, integration/connection, integration/connection-request).

file*file
Formatbinary
title?string
Lengthlength <= 200
title_lang?string
Lengthlength <= 8
folder?string

1.60.0 (1): the dropped folder's name — the file joins the Project's upload binding whose scope_rules.roots == [folder] (created on the first file), instead of Uploads. One path segment; refused with SUBPATH_INVALID otherwise.

Lengthlength <= 200
relative_path?string

1.60.0: the file's path inside folder (webkitRelativePath without the folder itself) — becomes the source title; server-folder subpath rules (no .., no hidden segment) → SUBPATH_INVALID.

Lengthlength <= 512
classification?DataClassification

1.60.0: the class the drop gives a new folder binding (settings row); ignored for an existing one and for loose files.

Value in

  • "public"
  • "confidential"
  • "dsk"
  • "secret"
  • "top_secret"
